author: hulacuja
quote: This game is not grand theft auto, they took a bottle of pure alcohol and poured it all over this game to make it as sanitised as possible, this game is more along the lines of a “good boy dating simulator with a side of crime” than a grand theft auto game. GTA “fans”who have never played a GTA game before are the only ones giving this house husband chore game a 10 and review bombing the ocarina of time because it was received so much better, wait till the pc release and a discount on steam instead of spending 100 dollars on this garbage for around 25 fps because 30 is only the “target” frame rate remember. 13 year since the last game made by a completely different rockstar team and it’s showing. Dan houser said a female protagonist wouldn't do well with the type of game GTA is in 2008 and he was right. I’d give this game a 3 or 4 if it wasn’t for the soyboy rockstar glazers review bombing other games. But aside from that why would I have given it a 3 or 4 if it wasn’t for the review bombing of other games? Well the game just isn’t that nice to play, it’s lost all its edginess, the gun fights are slow and not overly fun, the bullets often snap onto the npcs even when the crosshair isn’t on the guy, the main character sounds like and looks like a recycled Arthur Morgan and has the same weight thing from rdr2, eat too much and you get fat and if you don’t eat you look ripped af, you can’t steal cars early on and you definitely can’t steal cars that are too near your starting house, you can no longer shoot strip clubs and you can’t shoot protected groups of people, rockstar said the relationship was optional and that was clearly a lie, the first chapter of the game feels like a chore that should have a big skip button, the story feels badly paced in parts and it’s definitely not as engaging as previous titles in the series, there’s a few bugs in the game that should have been found and fleshed out in the many years and huge budget this game had, your destructive power was reduced by a gun carry limit, cars are also limited without the proper tools to steal them and stealing them now has 2 or 3 buttons to press rather than 1 button like other games, fuel for your vehicle is now a thing for some reason, there’s a stupid karma system for killing people in violent crimes and there’s also a karma system for your relationship, the voice acting isn’t the best, and you can’t hire strippers anymore, now onto the good stuff. It looks nice overall it’s definitely one of the best looking games ever made, the radio stations have a very real feel to them, the ai reactivity is pretty good, the cars sound and look nice but do have some weird physics sometimes, the game definitely feels like it has big scale to it especially when walking in vice city and driving through all the roads across the island, the phone being like a menu for all your ingame activities is cool but it’s been done before, and the npcs do have diverse groups in all the different parts of the island, it’s got plenty of content though not all of it might be fun for everyone who just wants to play gta like the crime sandbox it’s supposed to be, overall gta6 was overhyped and most definitely not worth the 13 year wait especially when it’s been stripped of many things that made gta, well gta.
